note: QA master prompt samples. Every sample is ERROR-detection or DATA-correctness focused. Feature-gap, UX and competitor prompts belong on the smoke portal, not here.

samples.label: Smart Books — Full functional & data correctness
samples.description: Enter deterministic masters and vouchers, then reconcile ledgers, registers, trial balance, P&L and balance sheet.

samples.label: Smart Books — GST reconciliation
samples.description: Post taxed sales and purchases, then reconcile GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and the HSN summary against the vouchers.

samples.label: Smart Books — Bank statement import/export
samples.description: Round-trip the deterministic bank statement fixture and verify rows, totals, MIME and bad-MIME rejection.

samples.label: Contacts — Data integrity & CSV round trip
samples.description: Create, re-read, import and export contacts; catch trimmed, re-encoded or duplicated records.

samples.label: HRMS — Payroll & attendance correctness
samples.description: Verify gross, deductions, net pay, register totals and leave balances against known inputs.

samples.label: Financial Reporting — Statement correctness
samples.description: Import a trial balance and reconcile the balance sheet, P&L, cash flow and notes.

samples.label: Calendar — Scheduling & ICS correctness
samples.description: Check timezone handling, recurrence expansion and ICS import/export fidelity.

samples.label: Docs — Upload/download fidelity
samples.description: Hash-compare uploaded and downloaded documents, check metadata and reject mismatched types.

samples.label: Vault — Secure attachment fidelity
samples.description: Hash-compare stored attachments, verify metadata and confirm access checks hold.

samples.label: Secretarial — Statutory register correctness
samples.description: Reconcile shareholding, allotments and register exports against the entered records.

samples.label: Auditor — Working paper & sampling correctness
samples.description: Verify materiality recalculation, sample selection, sign-off state and attachment fidelity.

samples.label: Login only
samples.description: Sign-in smoke gate: credentials, Jump To, product host match, OTP walls. No data entry.

samples.label: Error pack — console, API and broken screens
samples.description: Sweep every module for console errors, failed requests, blank screens and dead navigation.

samples.label: Data integrity — entered vs stored vs displayed
samples.description: Enter known values and prove they survive save, reload, list view and derived totals.

samples.label: File import/export verification
samples.description: Round-trip synthetic fixtures and compare hash, MIME, structure, rows and numeric totals.

samples.label: Reports data verification
samples.description: Reconcile report totals with their rows, check filters actually filter, compare export to screen.

samples.label: Negative & validation paths
samples.description: Push invalid input at every form and confirm it is refused cleanly, with a named field message.
